title: Tom, alone

greeting.text: The bell, once. The backpacker from last night, on his own, wearing a woman's parka that does not fit him across the shoulders.
Hi. Sorry. Two coffees, and can we fill a water bladder?
He looks to his left for someone to finish the sentence. There is no one to his left.

annoyed: Look, is there a problem? He's fine. He's just tired.

notes.wrist: He has learned to take his hands out of his pockets. Veins. Hers, you think.
notes.reflection: His back, facing the right way this time. He has been practising.

topics.answer: Jess is wrecked. She's not really talking.
She came back for me. So I kept some.

topics.ask: You still haven't got a shadow, Tom.

wren.arrive: Oh, he's doing both voices now. That's sweet.
wren.adviceLine: You served him last night and the sky didn't fall. He's a regular now. Two coffees, Sam.

serve.text: He holds the door for nobody, and waits, and follows them out.

turnAway.text: It is what he said last night, when she asked him to say something.

break.text: You let us both go. This is what that looks like.
He zips her parka up to the chin and walks out into the fog.

report.serve: A man bought two coffees at Corrigan's overnight and carried them both away. The woman he was collected with yesterday has not been seen since the roadblock.
report.turnAway: A man in a woman's parka was seen walking the pass road, stopping every few metres to hold a door that was not there.
report.shelter: Corrigan's reports a walker sheltering. Rangers ask: only the one?
report.break: A woman's parka has been found folded on the kerb at Corrigan's. The pockets were full of hair.
report.missed: A man waited at Corrigan's door overnight, saying two people's lines.
